Experience with a reason

My professional journey

With 16 years in the financial space, I focus on helping clients nationwide secure their financial futures. I focus on effective strategies to accumulate or generate retirement income while protecting those assets from risk. As a Navy veteran, I bring a disciplined approach to financial planning, emphasizing the importance of preparedness and security.

I hold a Bachelor of Arts in Economics from The Ohio State University and an MBA in Finance and Marketing from the University of Georgia's Terry College of Business. My career spans from military service as a Supply Corps Officer in the Navy to a decade in corporate America. My experience enables me to offer valuable insights to clients navigating their retirement or personal financial journeys.
